# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan Blames Adam for His Fall

---

**1** 'And it is because of you, Adam, that I was thrown down from heaven to this earth. My grief is laid upon you.'

**2** 'What is my fault in this?' Adam said. 'I did not do this — God alone did. Why have you directed your evil at me?'

**3** The devil said: 'I turned my evil against you because you are the cause of my expulsion. God your Lord gave you everything and created the whole world for you. And because of you I was driven out and exiled from my home.'

**4** 'When you were settled in paradise, I was thrown out. I said to myself: "If he gets to live in happiness while I suffer in exile, I will make him suffer too — so he can be exiled just like me."'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
